articles.headline: Inde Navarrette Sets Best Actress Oscar Campaign for ‘Obsession’ as Focus Features Mounts Full Awards Push (EXCLUSIVE)
articles.summary: Variety reports that Focus Features will campaign Navarrette for best actress for Obsession as part of a broader awards effort for the film. The report describes a campaign, with nominations still to be decided.
articles.evidence: Opened licensed Variety Australia article. Visible publication date is September 3, 2026; the body explicitly names Navarrette and the best actress campaign.
articles.accessNote: Licensed Australian edition was readable. Linked Variety U.S. original returned HTTP 402.

articles.headline: ‘X-Men’ Movie Casts Inde Navarrette as Rogue, Christopher Abbott as Prof. X, Adam Driver as Mr. Sinister and Maya Boyd as Storm
articles.summary: Variety reports that Kevin Feige announced Navarrette as Rogue during Marvel Studios’ D23 presentation. The article lists the newly announced cast and a planned May 2028 release.
articles.evidence: Opened licensed Variety Australia article. Visible publication date is August 16, 2026. Body attributes the casting announcement directly to Feige at D23, rather than reporting a casting rumor.
articles.accessNote: Date is the accessible Australian edition's publication date. Linked U.S. article returned HTTP 402; do not substitute its date without verification.

articles.headline: Obsession Is Breaking Records and Making Movie History
articles.summary: Focus Features marks Obsession becoming the distributor’s highest-grossing film worldwide, citing trade coverage of its first four theatrical weekends. Navarrette is identified as the film’s female lead.
articles.evidence: Opened official distributor article. Visible date is June 8, 2026; opening paragraph explicitly identifies Navarrette in the starring role. This is studio publicity and its commercial claims are attributed in the summary.

articles.headline: How Obsession's Inde Navarrette Went From Twitch Streamer to Scream Queen
articles.summary: Navarrette discusses building Nikki’s physical performance, working with director Curry Barker and approaching the film’s most demanding scenes. The interview also explores her interest in continuing to work in horror.
articles.evidence: Opened direct Q&A by Josh Svetz with visible June 5, 2026 date. Questions and answers concern the character, performance and production. The summary excludes the profile's personal background.
articles.accessNote: Full text readable. Source contains major film spoilers; summary avoids plot revelations.

articles.headline: Inde Navarrette on Obsession and the Actresses Who Inspire Her
articles.summary: In a Rotten Tomatoes and Focus Features interview, Navarrette discusses playing Nikki and the balance of humor and seriousness during filming. She also names performances and films that have influenced her.
articles.evidence: Opened RT Staff article dated May 18, 2026. Editorial description identifies a direct interview with Navarrette and explains the professional topics discussed.
articles.accessNote: Article readable; embedded video not separately viewed. Summary is limited to the article's editorial description.

articles.headline: Obsession’s Filmmaker Takes Horror to the Next Scary Level
articles.summary: Curry Barker explains the casting of Obsession and how Navarrette shaped Nikki beyond his initial conception of the character. The filmmaker also discusses the visual choices used to support her performance.
articles.evidence: Opened official Focus News Q&A dated May 15, 2026. The casting answer names Inde and describes her contribution to Nikki; subsequent answers discuss photographing the character.

articles.headline: Superman & Lois: Inde Navarrette Talks Impact of Sarah’s Actions in “Collision Course” (Exclusive)
articles.summary: Navarrette discusses the acting challenges in Sarah’s storyline following the season-three episode Collision Course. She explains how the character’s decisions affect her growth over the following episodes.
articles.evidence: Opened article by Nicole Drum with visible date May 31, 2023. It quotes Navarrette directly about acting the storyline and Sarah's development.
articles.accessNote: Full article readable. Contains episode spoilers.

articles.headline: Inde Navarrette on Bringing Humanity to Superman & Lois
articles.summary: Navarrette explains how she prepared to play Sarah Cushing, including research into Lana Lang and conversations with the show’s creative team. She discusses portraying the character’s family dynamics and emotional life.
articles.evidence: Opened direct Q&A by Russ Burlingame dated March 9, 2021. The article introduces an interview with Navarrette and contains her first-person account of preparing and performing the role.

articles.headline: "13 Reasons Why" Star Inde Navarrette On Bringing to Life Monty's Sister, Estela, in the Show's Final Season
articles.summary: Navarrette discusses joining the final season of 13 Reasons Why as Estela and developing the character’s perspective. The interview also covers her preparation for Superman & Lois.
articles.evidence: Opened exclusive interview by Tamara Fuentes. The publisher displays June 19, 2020; Wikipedia's June 11 reference differs, so the publisher's displayed date is used.
articles.accessNote: Full article readable. Summarize only role and craft discussion; omit personal identity and family material.

policy.include: Use named, accountable entertainment trades; official studio, network, festival and awards-body announcements; and direct professional interviews from publications with editorial oversight. Require a substantive connection to her credited work, casting, releases, performances, awards, or public professional appearances. Store the publisher's visible publication date, exact source link, and a brief original summary.
policy.exclude: Exclude relationship speculation, paparazzi or private-life coverage, anonymous insider rumors, fan casting, unsourced social posts, engagement bait, biographical scrape sites and articles that merely mention her. Keep award campaigns distinct from nominations or wins, and reported meetings distinct from confirmed casting.
policy.automation: An approved domain and a matching name are discovery signals, not editorial verification. Mark automated candidates clearly and check headline/body for relevance, date and rumor language before granting Reviewed status. Deduplicate syndication and updates; permit both spellings only for discovery. Avoid wholesale article or image reuse.
policy.publisherNotes: Official studio material is reliable for its own releases and direct interviews but should be visibly labeled as studio news. Broader outlets such as GQ, Seventeen and ComicBook.com qualify here because these individual articles are direct professional interviews, not because every article on those domains is suitable.
